full_page.content:
1928, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 20 Wm. Heimbuck wants Housekeeper - 1870 Church St. & Cor. 12th Father son, 2 daughter - phone Glendale 1275
Mrs. Mulhollan
Agnes Naurocki - appendicitis since last September - Enrolled Palm Sunday decided to have operation. In one week was home from hospital.
Mr. Donahue - Cancer going home To-day Mrs. Martin near Flint - Cancer Wm. Fox Family - Farm of 40 acres to sell ( 1297 Penn'a Ave. ) - out of work - not able to run farm himself Mrs. Graveline - Vomiting since Sunday Carmala Romeo - 7 paralised since 7 months old
Page 21 May 5 Mrs. Helen Hayes, 815 Beaconsfield, Grosse pt. park, dying in child birth - given up by seven doctors - is enrolled in S.M.A. - Husband promising weekly Comunion. To-day both come to Monastery.
Mrs. Maycock - dying of tuberculosis in Ford's Hospital - given up by doctors - who refuse to give more medicine
August Devogt - 3432 Monroe - leakage of both valves of heart - prom- ises to attend Mass 90 days - sick 5 yrs. 2 mo. - 1 day - is now working.
Mrs. Florence Klups - 8 month sick - doctors can't help rather dis- couraged. Miss kelly - Bone in throat Miss Duggan - cancer - brain Hanavan 4 yrs. Blind Susette Raunde
Page 22 Mrs. Mary Laethem - 3 small children - in St. Joseph's Retreat 4 months when enrolled - Now O.K. Deo Gratias
